explanation: Erdős #353, lead question: every measurable set of infinite measure in ℝ² contains the vertices of an isosceles trapezoid of area 1. IsIsoscelesTrapezoid (ccw convex quadrilateral, AB ∥ CD, equal diagonals) is the standard inclusive definition, and area is taken as the measure of the convex hull. Koizumi (2025) proved this, as the site records, and a Lean proof is linked. The statement is correct and solved.
